Same tiny short torso and legs as image1: distance chin-to-feet only 46% of ornament-top-to-chin, match ORIGINAL face width and vivid purple-cyan eyes, small star highlights, pale lavender-white hair, delicate soft outlines. Do not elongate legs or enlarge eyes. NEW MOTION: understated relaxed side-to-side weight transfer with two short light sticks at chest height, wrists leading small alternating arcs. Both feet take part: left supporting foot + right heel rises slightly in frame2; return center frame3; right supporting foot + left heel rises slightly in frame5; return center frame6. Waist has a small coherent counter-tilt (not frozen, not a sudden twisting pose), knees softly flex with weight shift. Timeline frame1 center sticks diagonally up; frame2 lean slightly left sticks tilt left; frame3 ease back center; frame4 begin lean right with sticks crossing slightly in front of chest; frame5 right gentle maximum, left heel slightly lifted; frame6 ease almost back to frame1. Complete painted poses, no separate body parts, no rotation-rig pieces, no action streaks, no detached glowing particles, no background color, no shadows, no text, generous transparent cell gutters. Smooth small evenly spaced pose changes throughout and across frame6→frame1.

Draw exactly TWO full-body keyframes side by side on transparent background, high quality 1536x1024. IMPORTANT pose anatomy: both short thighs go from hips toward screen LEFT, both rounded knees at same height, two connected short shins swing from knees. In LEFT KEYFRAME the FAR leg, the one attached to image-left knee, extends forward down-left at 35 degrees while the NEAR leg attached to image-right knee bends back down-right at 20 degrees. In RIGHT KEYFRAME swap their actions: FAR leg now bends back down-right, NEAR leg extends forward down-left across in front. Both shoes point toward screen LEFT, show shoe side/top, NEVER bottom of sole facing camera. This is two opposite extrema of alternating seated leg swing. Clearly show two distinct complete thighs, knees, calves, boots with natural overlapping, no gaps or separate floating shins. Do not keep same leg extended in both pictures. Reference is only character design; redraw whole seated poses. Very sharp clean transparent edges without glow, shadow, particle specks, text or labels. Keep large margins and full hair entirely inside each half. Head ornament-top-to-chin is about twice torso-and-leg height; seated legs are short and cute, not humanly long.
